titre: Encours mondiaux des fonds indiciels cotés
sous_titre: En milliers de Mds $, de fin 2024 à juillet 2026

series.nom: Encours mondiaux des fonds indiciels cotés

fin 2024.texte: Assets have grown 14.5% year-to-date, rising from $14.85 trillion at the end of 2024.

juin 2025.texte: Assets invested in the ETFs industry globally reached a new record of US$16.99 trillion at the end of June.

fin 2025.texte: Assets increased 16.6% YTD in 2026, going from $19.84 Tn at end of 2025 to $23.11 Tn.

juillet 2026.texte: Assets invested in the ETFs industry globally reached a new record of $23.11 Tn at the end of July.
